findings.trigger_condition: equal hashable and unhashable values in the stream
findings.root_cause: hash_buckets and unhashable_nodes are never cross-checked in _id_of
findings.impact: equal values become phantom duplicate vertices; dedup and layer content wrong
findings.suggested_validation: edges=[('a',1),('a',Flex(1))] should yield two logical nodes, current code yields three

findings.trigger_condition: large acyclic stream with unhashable nodes or mixed hashable lookups
findings.root_cause: no index for unhashable values; unhashable branch scans both registries and hashable lookups scan unhashable_ids
findings.impact: O(N^2) comparisons on deep unhashable inputs can exceed time limits
findings.suggested_validation: time chain ([i],[i-1]) N=50000 and observe ~4x slowdown when N doubles
